sql: SELECT y.trip_date, y.trips AS trips, d.d_day_name AS day_name FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21', DATE '2024-11-28') ORDER BY d.d_dow, y.trip_date LIMIT 500
